skills.name: Xeno's Scientific Sniper
skills.description: Snipes enemies with a rifle from a long distance. Bad effects on enemies.  *Enemy Skill Use Rate -30% (7 sec) *ATK per sec x 500% Area Damage (7 sec) *ATK x 3200% Area Damage

skills.name: The Job's Done
skills.description: Shoots his gun to the sky, good effect on allies.  *Cancels continuous damage  *ATK +260% (7 sec) *ATK Speed +260% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Dr. STONE
abilities.description: Dr. STONE Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy Knockback: Intelligence
abilities.description: Has a high chance of knocking back all Intelligence type enemies and canceling their invincibility skill effects when Rangers deploy. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - You must wait 6 seconds before you can use an Ability again after using one with the same effect on the same type of Ranger. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
